items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: That's George Ebronis. That's Charlie. That's the boy. And that's me. ... I see that band.

ctx.x: Babe Regis, yeah. This, I don't forget this fellow. That's George Ebronis. That's Charlie. That's the boy. And that's me. That's you. Yeah. I see that band. That's the part of the band of Chanty, New York. Mm-hmm. Yeah.
You know, Charlie Cordello doesn't play anymore. He gave up playing clarinet.
